messages:
Samir: Short thread to lock down owners/timelines from the KV-cache OOM follow-up. We need actionable items, who9s primary, who9s backup, and concrete abort criteria for tomorrow9s rollout.
Anya: I9ll own deep profiles + leak hypothesis validation. Plan: collect 3 snapshots per canary shard during low/high churn windows and diff. ETA: Fri EOD.
Javier: I'll do the config changes for per-shard soft_limit and the per-model prefix_warmer toggle. Rolling plan: 3% -> 15% -> 60% with 10m windows. Abort if p95 latency increases > 20ms or evictions spike > 2x.
Priya: Telemetry owner here. I9ll add two short-term metrics: fragmentation_ratio (per-shard) and kv_residency_bytes (per-model). I9ll create a regression alert: fragmentation_ratio delta > 12% for 15m.
Kai: I can add an emergency reclaim job that runs a fast slab_compact on targeted shards. Will have a toggle and safety: job requires two approvers. ETA: 48h.
Samir: Good. Let's map backups: Anya backup is Kai for profiling infra; Javier backup is Priya for config rollback automation; Priya backup is Samir for alerts.
Anya: Profiling commands I'll use (short):
```
# collect snapshot
kv_probe --shard=$SHARD --mode=resident --out=/artifacts/kv-${SHARD}-${TS}.snap
# generate diff
kv_diff /artifacts/kv-*.snap > /artifacts/diff-${TS}.txt
```
Artifacts will land in s3://redwood-oom/postmortem-2200122333/.
Javier: Config snippet I9m testing:
```
shard_defaults:
  soft_limit_ratio: 0.7
  eviction_policy: lru_aggressive
  prefix_warmer: { enabled: true, max_active: 4 }
```
I9ll add per-model override: prefix_warmer.enabled=false for models experiencing churn.
Priya: Runbook short steps for pager:
- Trigger: fragmentation_ratio > 12% OR evictions/sec > 150 for 10m
- Action 1: Set model-level prefix_warmer=false for top 3 hottest models
- Action 2: Throttle heavy writers (10% step)
- Action 3: If still high, run Kai9s slab_compact job (2 approvers)
- Escalate to infra after 30m if no improvement
I'll link this to the postmortem doc.
Kai: slab_compact job will be idempotent and honor drain mode. I9ll add safety: fail if CPU > 70% on node.
Samir: Deadlines recap:
- Profiling artifacts + upload (Anya) 12026-03-27 EOD
- Canary config + rollback automation (Javier) 12026-03-25 morning
- Alerts + dashboard tiles (Priya) 12026-03-26 EOD
- Emergency slab_compact job + toggle (Kai) 12026-03-27 48h from now
Make sure PRs reference the postmortem doc id.
Anya: One hypothesis: prefix index warmers hold transient pointers preventing slab compaction; will include stack traces and allocation sites. If confirmed, propose modifying warmer lifecycle to use weak refs.
Javier: Short-term mitigation: set prefix_warmer.max_active=0 per-model to disable warming while we fix. That9s safe to toggle in prod.
Priya: I9ll create an automated synthetic that churns prefixes and measures fragmentation before/after changes. Plan: run 3 cycles in staging before canary.
Samir: Meeting cadence: weekly follow-up for 6 weeks. First check-in Mon next week. Priya, please add calendar invite with owners.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder created: "KV fragmentation follow-up" 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC  attendees: eng-runtime.
Kai: Note: add a low-risk integration test that increases sequence_length to detect GC pressure from long-lived KV entries. Will add to ci/integration/kv_gc_test.
Javier: I9ll add rollback automation to the canary pipeline: if abort criteria hit, revert config and post a summary to the postmortem doc channel.
Priya: If anyone touches alerts/dashboards, tag @Priya so I can validate. I9ll also add a Grafana snapshot link in the playbook.
Samir: Thanks. If owners slip, assign a blocker and page me. We need tight follow-through until the regression window closes. :thumbsup:
